steps.content: With the last drumbeat echoing, three guards eye you down disdainfully, making a slow, deliberate descent.

In their cages, the performers let out piercing screams, sneering and snapping at the three figures approaching them. Their hands reach out, almost with a desperate craving to grab and consume them entirely.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Alright, you despicable lot, cut the smug faces around here.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: One wrong move, and my baton will make sure your tongues remember it.

The baton's clash against the prison bars resonates with a thunderous "thud," reverberating intensely. The crowd instinctively recoils, with many in the audience visibly shaken, a clear sign of their intimidation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quite the opener... it almost had me going for a second.
You spontaneously burst into applause. There's something about seeing a performance like this up close—it's more impactful, filled with a tangible sense of strength and belief.
Seems like this trip was a good call after all.

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: See that? Scared stiff, aren't you? So here's a tip: don't go around saying things that'll tick them off. Watch out, or you'll get a taste of their baton!

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: Honestly, just forget about them for now. Why don't you tell us what mischief got you thrown into this mess?

Shortly after, you see the "prisoners" around Ignis casually striking up conversations again. They appear to be quite familiar with the "prison guard" role by now, engaging Ignis in a bit of light-hearted banter.
Luckily, the performers seem to have caught on that Ignis isn't exactly a natural at this acting thing. They tone down their voices, making it easier for her.

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: What else would it be! Guys? Gals? Cash?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What, no! That's not why I'm here... Hold on, I'm not even a performer...

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: Hey, it's typical for newcomers, still clinging to the hope of going back to Eastside... Ah, I meant, back to the outside world. Give it a bit, you'll adjust.
You spot someone in the cell opposite Ignis, craning her neck to get a better look at you.
Her clothes suggest she's just another spectator like you, but she boldly steers the conversation, winking at Ignis.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: ...No, it's not what you... think...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: If any of you... know anything about them... please, let me know...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: My friends, the one in a gray coat seemed fragile, and the other was strikingly good-looking, like a movie star...

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: See, I told you, it's always about the people!

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Oh dear, ain't you a romantic one?

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: Come on, it's all fine, tell me about it!
In the glow of the lights, you notice Ignis's ears blushing the same shade as her hair, her expression a tangle of awkwardness. With effort, she finally ekes out a few words.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Please, ladies, I just... want to find them... Can you... let me out, please?

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: My, you're such a cutie! You wanna go out and find them?

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Here's a secret between us, we've got a plan. The question is... do you have the guts for it?

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: Guts or not, you're already in this. There's only one way outta here.
The spectator, now fully engrossed in the play, grabs to the bars and joins in the fun. With just that one line, she draws all eyes back to herself.
But she doesn't seem used to being the center of attention so suddenly. After a series of ums and ahs, she finally manages to blurt out something.

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: Cough, hey, isn't it just... you know, a jailbreak? This is a cell, so that's the only way... you know, to escape...

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: Hey, look at the brains on the new kid! So if you want a way out, the only option left is a jailbreak~

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Hey, new girl, stick with us when we make a run for it later!

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: Nah, I'm too lazy to budge now. This place is perfect, no infuriating families or heart-breaking partners to deal with. Might as well consider my wish granted!

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: What wish is that?

steps.speaker: Prisoner C
steps.content: Wealth, idleness and a dead husban...
She spoke her last words in a hush, but they were met with bursts of hearty laughter.

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Hahahahah. Anyway, that's the plan. Girly, if you're thinking of getting out, stick with us when we make a run for it.
The one caged wiped tears of laughter from her eyes, gesturing towards the stretching, shadowy hallway behind.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Will that way lead me to my friends?

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Not sure, but if you're planning to get out of this place, that's your only shot. Make it to the end of that corridor, find the one to lead us, and get the hell outta here!
You and a few sharp-eyed spectators are glued to the end of the corridor when abruptly, a shrill whistle cuts through the air again.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Attention—!!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Yard time! Don't just stand there like idiots, get out here, all of you!!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Do whatever you want, just don't do anything stupid! Whether to trust others and who to trust, it's your life on the line!

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: And if anyone dares try anything on me... heh, I'll be waiting!
The cell doors swing open in a flash. The performers bolt out, leaping and singing in a wild revelry, sprinting towards the dark corridor.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Yo, bro, come on! We need to find the one in charge! Find the star of this show! I'm sure if we follow that person, it will lead us to all the fun stuff!
steps.female_content: Yo, sis, come on! We need to find the one in charge! Find the star of this show! I'm sure if we follow that person, it will lead us to all the fun stuff!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: Let's go! Let's find that leader!
Spectators beside you are excited to join in, following in the performers' footsteps.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: S-sure, I'll be right there.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: First time on this side of the bars, and who knew it'd be such a blast!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You... Well, glad you're enjoying it.
After being sidetracked by this guy, you realize you've fallen behind Ignis. The cell she's in is already vacant.
The memory of her earnest look just moments ago brings a warmth to your heart, and a smile naturally crosses your face.
Now, the area's nearly empty of people. Your smile catches the attention of a few prison guards behind you, who watch you with stern, piercing gazes.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: What, are you really fond of this cage?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: Fancy a tour down the hallway? The rooms are full of people who've got a thing for cages, all hand-picked by me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Uh? No... no, I'm on my way out, right this second.
You pocket that small flicker of emotion, give a respectful bow to the three, and hurry off towards the hallway.
